segment.why: bars 5 to about 13: the intro figure with thumb slaps (bars 5-8) then verse 1, whose melody jumps to frets 7-9 above the capo; fretting hand moves away from the capo, bass on strings 5 and 6, pull-offs; bars 5-8 already read and timed in the check

picks.fame: very famous (One Direction single, 2014); the solo arrangement and its fingering are Gareth's own
picks.rights_notable: a cover of a major-label composition (One Direction / Sony Music); the video is a third-party mirror with no licence; his tabs are now sold

The tuning pick trades rhythm in the truth for a real altered tuning, an unknown original and a second player.
